name: Rizky Fajar
title: Chess Athlete & High School Student
bio: I am a high school student and competitive chess athlete dedicated to strategic excellence. Balancing academic pursuits with intensive training schedules, I represent my region at national chess championships. My goal is to attain the FIDE Master title while pursuing excellence in computer science and mathematics.

achievements.title: Gold Medalist - National Student Chess Championship (O2SN)
achievements.description: Ranked #1 out of 64 regional champions in the high school category.

achievements.title: 1st Place - Jakarta Regional Junior Chess Championship
achievements.description: Won the U-17 category with an undefeated score of 6.5/7.

achievements.title: Best Junior Player - Indonesia Open Chess Tournament
achievements.description: Finished top among players under 18 in a field of international masters.

achievements.title: 2nd Place - National Junior Chess Championship (U-16)
achievements.description: Earned silver medal and secured a spot in the national youth training camp.

achievements.title: 3rd Place - High School Invitational Chess Blitz
achievements.description: Podium finish in a fast-paced blitz tournament (3 mins + 2 sec increment).

education.description: Discovered my passion for chess. Joined the school chess club and won my first primary school tournament, laying the foundation for my journey.
Began rigorous training and competed in regional championships. Developed strategic thinking, calculation skills, and tactical discipline.
Currently balancing academic excellence with professional chess training. Representing my school and region at national chess tournaments.
Future goal to pursue higher education in Computer Science or Mathematics, aiming to earn the FIDE Master title alongside my studies.
